name: era-0-0-47-upgrades-binary-content
description: the always-on outgoing upgrade preserves a legacy binary content part as typed media for a peer pinned to 0.0.47
kill: remove the always-on outgoing {type:binary} upgrade: outgoing enforcement then strips the legacy part, losing its image payload. This fixture retains its historical 0.0.47 peer pin; era-current-peer-keeps-modern-content separately proves the upgrade also runs for a current peer

dotnet.intentional: The compatibility shims are TypeScript client middleware and the .NET client has no equivalent — but it does not forward the legacy part either. AGUIMessageJsonConverter's input-content union is closed, so a {"type":"binary"} part throws "Unknown InputContent type: 'binary'" while the run input is being deserialized; this lane's BuildInput catches that per message and starts the run without it, so the WHOLE message — its conformant text part included — never reaches the agent. Neither upgraded nor forwarded: dropped. The empty messages list below is what pins that, in place of the `{}` that used to match any request at all. Alignment is tracked separately.
